[서술형-오류 수정] 다음 문장에서 틀린 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
Are the dog in the garden? No, it isn't.
questions.explanation: 'the dog'은 단수 주어이므로 의문문에서 'Are' 대신 'Is'를 사용해야 합니다.
acceptedAnswers: Is the dog in the garden? No, it isn't
Is the dog in the garden? No, it is not.
Is the dog in the garden? No, it'sn't.

questions.answer: He is not my brother. He is my cousin.
questions.question:
[서술형-오류 수정] 다음 문장에서 틀린 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
He not is my brother. He is my cousin.
questions.explanation: be동사의 부정문은 'be동사 + not'의 순서이므로 'not is'가 아닌 'is not'으로 써야 합니다.
acceptedAnswers: He isn't my brother. He is my cousin.
He is not my brother. He is my cousin
He's not my brother. He's my cousin.

questions.answer: Suho and I are on the same soccer team.
questions.question:
[서술형-오류 수정] 다음 문장에서 틀린 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
Suho and I is on the same soccer team.
questions.explanation: 'Suho and I'는 복수 주어이므로 'is' 대신 'are'를 사용해야 합니다.
acceptedAnswers: Suho and I are on the same soccer team

questions.answer:
(1) This are → This is
(2) He are → He is
(3) is → are (Max and I are best friends.)
questions.question:
[서술형-오류 수정] 다음 글에서 틀린 부분을 모두 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
This are my dog, Max. He are very cute. Max and I is best friends.
questions.explanation: 'This'와 'He'는 단수 주어이므로 'is'를 씁니다. 'Max and I'는 복수 주어이므로 'are'를 써야 합니다.
acceptedAnswers:
(1) This are → This is
(2) He are → He's
(3) is → are (Max and I are best friends.)
